# InteractionProcessStartRequest

Starts a run of an interaction: its inputs, and anything this run does differently from the definition.

**Kind:** an object, used in requests.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `inputs` | [`NameValuePair`](name-value-pair.md)`[]` | yes | The run's inputs, by name. Every required input must be given. Constraints: required (empty or whitespace-only strings are rejected). |
| `loomMappings` | [`LoomMappingRequest`](loom-mapping-request.md)`[] \| null` |  | The loom particular agents wake up with in this run, in place of the one the interaction would choose. |
| `loomGifts` | [`LoomStartGiftRequest`](loom-start-gift-request.md)`[] \| null` |  | Threads to hand to agents as they start, so they wake up knowing them, and knowing they were told. |
| `aiModelOverrides` | [`AiModelOverrideRequestInput`](ai-model-override-request.md#in-a-request)`[] \| null` |  | Agents to run on a different model in this run. |
| `responseJsonSchema` | `string \| null` |  | A JSON Schema the run's answer must match, in place of the interaction's own. Must be a valid JSON Schema. |
| `disabledTools` | `string[] \| null` |  | The names of tools this run's agents are not given. |
| `credentials` | [`InteractionProcessCredentialRequest`](interaction-process-credential-request.md)`[] \| null` |  | Model provider keys of yours for this run. Calls use these first, then your tenant's model keys. |
| `allowMaitentoFallback` | `boolean \| null` |  | Whether an agent may fall back to Maitento's own key once your keys for its provider are used up or have failed (and only when your tenant allows it). Null or false: it may not, and the turn fails instead. |
| `credentialStack` | `string \| null` |  | The credential stack the run uses, by id or name. Its credentials serve every model call, in the stack's order, and Maitento's own keys are never used. Leave it out to use the interaction's own stack, then the namespace's default, then your tenant's. Can't be combined with `credentials`. |
| `durationAutoTerminationOverride` | `timespan \| null` |  | The longest this run may take, in place of the interaction's own limit. Null: the interaction's. |
| `durationWarningOverride` | `timespan \| null` |  | How long into this run the agents are told that time is running short, in place of the interaction's own setting. Null: the interaction's. |
| `swarmLimits` | [`InteractionSwarmLimitsRequestInput`](interaction-swarm-limits-request.md#in-a-request)`\| null` |  | Narrows how far the sub-interactions this run's participants start may spread: each limit given becomes the lesser of it and the definition's, and each left out is not narrowed. It can never widen them. Null: the definition's limits. |
| `webDownloadPartitionId` | `uuid \| null` |  | The temporary knowledge base (partition) the run's web fetches are kept in. Null: the namespace's default, then the tenant's. A run whose agents may fetch, with none of the three, is refused (`api:web:download-partition-required`). Runs it starts use it too. |
| `webAccessOverrides` | [`WebAccessOverrideInput`](web-access-override.md#in-a-request)`[] \| null` |  | Per-agent overrides of the agents' web tools for this run. |

## Example

```json
{
  "inputs": [
    {
      "name": "...",
      "value": "..."
    }
  ],
  "loomMappings": [
    {
      "agentName": "...",
      "id": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
      "namespaceId": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
      "name": "...",
      "namespaceName": "..."
    }
  ],
  "loomGifts": [
    {
      "agentName": "...",
      "fromLoomId": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
      "threadIds": [],
      "note": "...",
      "givenBy": "..."
    }
  ],
  "aiModelOverrides": [
    {
      "agentName": "...",
      "modelName": "...",
      "customModel": {},
      "purpose": "Agent"
    }
  ],
  "responseJsonSchema": "...",
  "disabledTools": [
    "..."
  ],
  "credentials": [
    {
      "provider": "...",
      "apiKey": "...",
      "baseUrl": "...",
      "modelNameOverrides": {
        "key": "..."
      },
      "credentialId": "...",
      "isOwnLicense": false,
      "priority": 0
    }
  ],
  "allowMaitentoFallback": false,
  "credentialStack": "...",
  "durationAutoTerminationOverride": "00:05:00",
  "durationWarningOverride": "00:05:00",
  "swarmLimits": {
    "maxDepth": 0,
    "maxConcurrent": 0,
    "maxTotal": 0
  },
  "webDownloadPartitionId": "3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4e6b-9c7d-2a1b0c9d8e7f",
  "webAccessOverrides": [
    {
      "agentName": "...",
      "search": false,
      "fetch": false
    }
  ]
}
```

## Where it's used

- [`interactions.start`](../api/interactions.md) (`PUT /interactions/processes/by-id/{id}/start`)
- [`interactions.start`](../api/interactions.md) (`PUT /namespaces/{namespaceName}/interactions/by-name/{name}/start`)
